findings.evidence: CoprimeCosets.lean:225-235: `lemma exists_mem_Gamma1_natDiagGL_mul_eq_primeRep_none (hp : 0 < p) (hσ10 : σ 1 0 = (N : ℤ)) (hσ11 : σ 1 1 = (p : ℤ)) : ∃ γ, γ ∈ Gamma1 N ∧ natDiagGL 2 ![1, p] * mapGL ℚ γ = primeRep σ p none`, whose witness is `!![σ 0 0 * p, σ 0 1; N, 1]`. CoprimeCosets.lean:121 `coe_primeRep_none` gives `!![σ00 * p, σ01; σ10 * p, σ11]`. Only `0 < p` is required, as in this branch.
findings.fix: Let `σ : SL(2, ℤ) := ⟨!![a * f, b * c'; N, p], by rw [Matrix.det_fin_two_of]; linear_combination hσ⟩`. Get `⟨γ, hγ, hDγ⟩ := exists_mem_Gamma1_natDiagGL_mul_eq_primeRep_none hp (σ := σ) (by simp) (by simp)`. Then show `conj = mapGL ℚ τ' * primeRep σ p none = mapGL ℚ τ' * natDiagGL 2 ![1, p] * mapGL ℚ γ`, using `coe_primeRep_none` for the matrix of the twisted representative. This removes `hγdet`, the `show` product and the hand-built γ.
findings.issue: `exists_mem_Gamma1_mul_diag_mul_eq_conjDiag_twisted_of_bezout` re-derives the right factor `!![a f p, b c'; N, 1]` by hand: its determinant (`hγdet`), its Γ₁(N) membership, and the product `!![1,0;0,p] * γ = !![a f p, b c'; N p, p]` (the inline `show`). `twistTau_mul` then multiplies by `!![m p, n; N p, p]`, which is the matrix of `primeRep σ p none`. All of this is already `exists_mem_Gamma1_natDiagGL_mul_eq_primeRep_none` for σ = !![a f, b c'; N, p].
